title: Uilta language - Wikipedia
text: Uilta (Orok: ульта, also called Ulta, Ujlta, [a] or Orok) is a Tungusic language spoken in the Poronaysky and Nogliksky Administrative Divisions of Sakhalin Oblast, in the Russian Federation, by the Uilta people.
